_comment: @nself/tsconfig/base — canonical strict base. EVERY nSelf repo's tsconfig.json MUST `extends: @nself/tsconfig/base` rather than hand-rolling compilerOptions. Mirrors packages/tsconfig.base.json so the strict guarantee (strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + noImplicitReturns + exactOptionalPropertyTypes) is enforced in one place. Drift from these flags is a build error.
